title: Numerická slovná úloha (A–D)
description: Word problem with quantities; convert to equation; pick numeric choice. Grounded in VSJP8 Téma 5 Ulohy/Riesenia.

quantities.description: Named numeric inputs used by deriveCorrectKey

renderChoices: A–D from correct + distractors (shuffle locked at generation time; store final order)

deriveCorrectKey.solverHint: t5.lever_balls | t5.trip_days_linear | t5.discount_reverse | custom expression over quantities
deriveCorrectKey.notes: Prefer closed-form recompute over LLM self-check.

rationalePattern: Show equation → arithmetic → final value matching correct choice letter.
